words.ex: Jenny is eating an apple.
words.en: A jenny is a female donkey or a spinning machine.

words.ex: He lives in Canada.
words.en: Canada is a country in North America consisting of ten provinces and three territories. Located in the northern part of the continent, it extends from the Atlantic Ocean in the east to the Pacific Ocean in the west and northward into the Arctic Ocean.

words.tr: n. 手（尤用于与幼儿说话时）；侦察用车
words.ex: Come here, Danny, and hold my hand.
words.en: A male given name, often a short form of Daniel; also a common name for characters in stories and media.

words.tr: int. 谢谢； n. 感谢；“thank”的复数；
words.ex: Thanks for helping me.
words.en: an expression of gratitude

words.ex: The student reads a book every day.
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university or college.

words.ex: I have four apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of three and one; one more than three.

words.ex: I have five apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of two and three; one more than four, or half of ten.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.ex: Jones is a teacher at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 琼斯是当地一所学校的老师。
words.en: A common surname or given name; also used informally to refer to a person.

words.tr: n. 学生接受指导的教室
words.ex: The students gather in homeroom every morning.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每天早上在教室集合。
words.en: A homeroom is a classroom where a group of students in a school meet daily with the same teacher before starting their classes.

words.ex: Kate is reading a book.
words.en: A female given name, often a short form of Katherine.

words.ex: My classmate helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的同班同学帮我做了作业。
words.en: A classmate is someone who is in the same class as you at school or college.

words.ex: He used a jack to lift the car.
words.ex_cn: 他用千斤顶把车顶了起来。
words.en: A jack is a device for lifting heavy objects, especially one for raising the axle of a motor vehicle so that a wheel can be changed or removed.

words.tr: v. 访问；参观；“visit”的现在分词； adj. 客座的；
words.ex: He is visiting his grandmother every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末都去看望他的奶奶。
words.en: Visiting is the present participle of visit, which means to go to see someone or something in a particular place.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: Playing games with friends is fun.
words.ex_cn: 和朋友一起玩游戏很有趣。
words.en: If you say that someone is fun or that they are fun to be with, you mean that you enjoy being with them because they make you feel happy and amused.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.ex: He used an eraser to remove the pencil mark.
words.ex_cn: 他用橡皮擦掉了铅笔印。
words.en: An eraser is a piece of rubber or other material that you use to remove pencil or pen marks from paper.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.ex: My birthday is in May.
words.en: May is the fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

words.ex: Please excuse me for being late.
words.en: To excuse someone means to forgive them for something they have done wrong or to allow them not to do something that they should do.

words.tr:
adj. 好的；不错的；可以的
int. 好的；可以
words.ex: The food is OK.
words.en: An expression meaning 'all right' or 'acceptable', used to indicate approval or agreement.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: I have two apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and one; one less than three.

words.ex: I have three apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and two; one more than two.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.tr:
adv. 后来；稍后；
adj. 后来的；稍后的；晚些的；晚年的；
words.ex: He left the party, and later he called his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，后来给朋友打了电话。
words.en: Later means after the present time or after the time you are talking about.

words.ex: This thing is very useful.
words.en: An object, fact, affair, circumstance, or concept considered as being a separate entity.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.ex: He has ten apples.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and two; one more than nine; 10.

words.ex: He has six apples on the table.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of three and two; one more than five, or four less than ten; 6.

words.ex: He has seven apples in his bag.
words.en: Seven is the number 7.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.ex: He has nine apples in his bag.
words.en: The number after eight and before ten.

words.ex: He has eight apples in his bag.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of two and four; one more than seven, or two less than ten; 8.

words.ex: The blacksmith forged a horse shoe.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠锻造了一个马蹄铁。
words.en: A smith is a person whose job is making and repairing things made of metal, especially by heating the metal and then shaping it.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.tr: n. 宽松的女短衫；女衬衫
words.ex: She wears a white blouse to work.
words.ex_cn: 她上班穿一件白色上衣。
words.en: A blouse is a piece of clothing for women, which covers their body from the neck to the waist or slightly below, and which usually has long sleeves and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.ex: Kim is playing soccer after school.
words.en: A common Korean surname or given name; also a female given name in English-speaking countries.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
adv. 出去；外出；离开；
v. 揭露；使熄灭；驱逐；
prep. 向外；在外面；
adj. 出局的；外面的；
words.ex: He walked out of the room.
words.en: If someone is out, they are not at home or not at their usual place of work. If something is out, it is not in its usual place. If you are out of something, you no longer have any of it. If something is out, it is available to the public. If a light or fire is out, it is no longer burning or shining. If a ball in a game is out, it is outside the area where it should be. If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. If you are out, you are no longer involved in a competition or activity because you have been defeated or have decided to stop.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.ex: He gave a quick bob when I greeted him.
words.ex_cn: 我向他打招呼时，他快速地点了点头。
words.en: A bob is a short haircut for a woman or girl. To bob means to move quickly up and down.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.ex: Lynn is walking to school.
words.en: A given name for females and sometimes males, of English origin, meaning 'lake' or 'waterfall'.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.ex: He wears a black hat every day.
words.en: A hat is a head covering which is worn for various reasons, including protection against weather conditions, ceremonial reasons such as university graduation, religious reasons, safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.tr:
n. 长裤子；短内裤； “pant”的复数
v. 喘气；喘息；“pant”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He is wearing blue pants.
words.en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles and divides into two parts to cover each leg separately.

words.tr: adj. 五彩缤纷的；丰富多彩的；
words.ex: The children painted a colourful picture.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们画了一幅五彩缤纷的画。
words.en: Something that is colourful has bright colours or a lot of different colours.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: Wow, that cake looks delicious!
words.ex_cn: 哇，那个蛋糕看起来真美味！
words.en: You say 'wow' when you are very impressed, surprised, or pleased by something.

words.ex: She wears a sari to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着纱丽去参加婚礼。
words.en: A sari is a traditional garment worn by women in India, consisting of a long piece of cloth that is draped around the body.

words.ex: India is a country in South Asia.
words.ex_cn: 印度是南亚的一个国家。
words.en: A country in South Asia, known for its diverse culture, history, and religions.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园在城市的中心。
words.en: The centre of something is the middle of it.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.tr:
n. 部分；局部；角色；零件；
v. 分离；分开；
words.ex: This part of the book is very easy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常简单。
words.en: A part is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that together with others constitute a whole.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.ex: The robin sang loudly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 知更鸟在早晨大声歌唱。
words.en: A small bird with a red breast, known for its melodious song.

words.ex: The robot cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人每天打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine that is programmed to move and perform certain tasks automatically.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.tr: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的； v. “scare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was scared of the dark.
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.tr:
n. 波；波浪；海浪；
v. 挥手；挥舞；招手；
words.ex: The wave hit the shore softly.
words.en: A wave is a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea or a lake. To wave means to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air, usually in order to say hello or goodbye to someone.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.ex: The table is two metres long.
words.en: A metre is a unit of length in the metric system, equal to 100 centimetres.

words.tr: n. 少许；小块；片刻； v. “bite”的过去式；
words.ex: Can you give me a bit of sugar?
words.en: A bit is a small piece or quantity of something.

words.tr: prep. 反对；与…相反；倚着；违反；碰；对着；
words.ex: He spoke against the new law.
words.en: In opposition to; contrary to; in contact with.

words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.ex: He ate a donut for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个甜甜圈。
words.en: A donut is a small, circular cake, typically with a hole in the center, fried and often covered with sugar or icing.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。
words.en: as much or as many as required.

words.tr:
v. 笑；发笑；
n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: He laugh when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只滑稽的猫时笑了。
words.en: To laugh means to make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.ex: Jim is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 吉姆正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A common male given name, often used as a familiar or informal term for James.

words.ex: He had a stomachache after eating too much ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多冰淇淋后胃痛。
words.en: A stomachache is a pain in your stomach.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.tr: abbr. 出票；提存；提款；“drawing”的缩写
words.ex: The dr. was signed on the ticket.
words.en: Dr. is a title used before the name of a doctor or someone who has a PhD.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.ex: He said 'achoo' when he sneezed.
words.en: used to represent the sound of a sneeze.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.tr:
v. 停留；保持；
n. 停留；逗留；
words.ex: He will stay at home tonight.
words.en: To stay means to continue to be in a particular place or situation, or to remain in a specified state or condition.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: There are twelve apples on the table.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of three and four; one more than eleven, or two less than fourteen; 12.

words.ex: The blond man smiled at the children.
words.ex_cn: 那个白肤金发的男子对孩子们微笑了。
words.en: If someone has blond hair, it is pale yellow in color.

words.ex: There are thirteen apples on the table.
words.en: The number 13, which is one more than twelve and one less than fourteen.

words.tr: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；有趣的；
words.ex: The funny clown made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 那个滑稽的小丑让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Something that is funny is amusing and likely to make you laugh.

words.ex: He almost finished his homework.
words.en: You use almost to indicate that something is not completely the case but is nearly the case.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: I have fifteen apples.
words.en: The number 15.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.ex: Mary likes to walk her dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 玛丽每天早上都喜欢遛狗。
words.en: A female given name, often a short form of Mary or Marie.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.ex: She ate a cookie after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她在午饭后吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A cookie is a small sweet cake, typically round and flat, that is baked and often served as a snack.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.ex: He eats a grape every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗葡萄。
words.en: A grape is a small, round fruit that grows in bunches on a vine. Grapes can be green, red, or purple and are used for making wine, eating fresh, or drying into raisins.

words.ex: He eats a carrot every day.
words.en: A carrot is a long, thin, orange-colored vegetable that grows underground.

words.ex: He eats cabbage every day for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他每天午餐都吃卷心菜。
words.en: A cabbage is a round vegetable with thick green leaves wrapped around its short stem.

words.ex: He eats a watermelon every summer.
words.en: A watermelon is a large, round fruit with green skin, pink flesh, and black seeds.

words.tr:
adj. 甜的；悦人的；
n. 糖果；
words.ex: The cake is sweet and delicious.
words.en: Sweet is used to describe something that tastes of sugar or is pleasant in a way that is reminiscent of sugar. It can also describe something that is pleasing to the senses other than taste, such as a sound or smell, or something that is kind and gentle.

words.ex: She ate a ripe pear for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个熟透的梨当零食。
words.en: A pear is a sweet, juicy fruit that is narrow at the top and wider at the bottom. It has a thin green or brown skin, and white flesh.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: He has fourteen apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有十四个苹果。
words.en: The number 14.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: There are eleven apples on the table.
words.en: The number 11.

words.ex: She made dumplings for dinner.
words.en: A small lump of dough that is cooked and served with a meal, often as a side dish.

words.ex: I need something to eat.
words.en: Some thing or things that are not specified or known.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: He looked at the menu and chose pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他看了菜单，选择了意大利面。
words.en: A menu is a list of the food that is available at a restaurant or café.

words.tr:
v. 能；
n. 金属罐；
words.ex: I can swim very well.
words.en: Can is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. It is used to indicate that someone is able to do something or that something is possible.

words.ex: The factory uses coke to heat the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用焦炭来加热熔炉。
words.en: Coke is a solid fuel made by heating coal in the absence of air so that the volatile components are driven off. It is also a popular brand of soft drink.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: He has twenty apples in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他的包里有二十个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of two and ten; ten less than thirty; 20.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.tr: n. <美>外卖餐馆，外卖食品; （桥牌中）示意搭档改叫的叫牌 adj. 外卖的，供顾客带出外吃的
words.ex: I ordered pizza takeout for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我订了外卖披萨当晚餐。
words.en: Takeout refers to food that is prepared in a restaurant and is intended to be eaten elsewhere.

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.ex: I forgot to bring my book, p.s. I'll bring it tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我忘了带书，附言：我明天带来。
words.en: Used when you want to add extra information at the end of a letter or email.

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.ex: He is a good son to his parents.
words.en: A son is a male child in relation to his parents.

words.ex: My daughter loves to read books.
words.en: A daughter is a female child in relation to her parents.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.ex: The policeman stopped the car.
words.en: A policeman is a man who is a member of the police force.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.ex: The businessman sold his products to many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人把他的产品卖到了许多国家。
words.en: A businessman is a man who works in business, especially at a high level.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: We work together every day.
words.en: If people do something together, they do it with each other.

words.ex: He helped others without asking for anything.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助别人，没有要求任何回报。
words.en: Used to refer to additional people or things of the same type as those already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.ex: He has thirty books in his bag.
words.en: The number 30.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.ex: She put the apples in a basket.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个篮子里。
words.en: A basket is a container which is usually made of stiff fibers, such as rushes, straw, or thin strips of wood, and is used for carrying or storing things.

words.tr: n. 漫游者；流浪者；漂泊者；
words.ex: The rover explored the surface of Mars.
words.ex_cn: 漫游者探索了火星表面。
words.en: A rover is someone who travels around, often without a fixed route or destination. It can also refer to a vehicle designed to travel over the rough surface of a planet or moon.

words.ex: She put a red tablecloth on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上铺了一块红色的桌布。
words.en: A tablecloth is a cloth used to cover a table. Some are mainly ornamental coverings, which may also help protect the table from scratches and stains.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: The child is quiet during nap time.
words.en: Making little or no noise; free from disturbance or tumult; tranquil; calm.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的过去式；
words.ex: She picked a red rose from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵红玫瑰。
words.en: A rose is a flower, often with a pleasant smell, which grows on a bush with thorns on the stems.

words.tr:
n. 谜语；费解的事
v. 解谜；出谜；使布满窟窿；打洞
words.ex: He told me a riddle and I solved it.
words.ex_cn: 他给我出了一道谜语，我解出来了。
words.en: A riddle is a question or statement that is deliberately very confusing and has a clever or amusing answer.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.tr:
n. 纬纱；纬线；织物
int. 汪汪（狗叫声）
words.ex: The weaver pulled the woof through the warp.
words.en: The sound made by a dog, or to make such a sound.

words.ex: Jane likes to read books after school.
words.en: A female given name, often a short form of Jane or Janet.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.tr: abbr. 快速随机询问显示（Fast Random Enquiry Display）
words.ex: Fred is my neighbor.
words.en: A male given name, often short for Frederick or Alfred.

words.ex: Heidi is reading a book about horses.
words.ex_cn: 海蒂正在读一本关于马的书。
words.en: A female given name, often associated with the novel 'Heidi' by Johanna Spyri.

words.ex: She accidentally dropped the teacup and it shattered into pieces.
words.ex_cn: 她不小心把茶杯掉在地上，摔得粉碎。
words.en: A teacup is a small cup from which tea is drunk.

words.ex: He bought a novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A bookstore is a shop where books are sold.

words.tr:
n. 骑；乘坐；
v. 骑；乘坐；
words.ex: He gave me a ride on his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他让我骑了他的自行车。
words.en: To sit on and control the movement of an animal, especially a horse, or to travel in or on a vehicle or other conveyance.

words.tr: adj. 破损的；弄坏的； v. 打破；打断；“break”的过去分词；
words.ex: The broken cup lay on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 破了的杯子躺在地板上。
words.en: Damaged or shattered into pieces, typically as a result of force or impact.

words.tr:
adv. 离；断开；
prep. 离开；脱落；
adj. 空闲的；远离的；
int. 走开；
words.ex: The boat moved off from the shore.
words.en: If something is off, it is not on or is not being used.

words.tr: adj. 丢失的； v. 丢失；输；“lose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lost keys were found under the table.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙在桌子下面找到了。
words.en: If you are lost, you do not know where you are or you are unable to find your way.

words.ex: The lady is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 这位女士正在等公交车。
words.en: A lady is a woman who is polite, well-mannered, and refined.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.ex: He won the lottery by pure luck.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是靠运气中了彩票。
words.en: Luck is the force that causes things, especially good things, to happen to you by chance and not as a result of your own efforts or abilities.

words.tr: adj. 新鲜的；新的；刚发生的；
words.ex: She bought fresh apples from the market.
words.ex_cn: 她从市场买了新鲜的苹果。
words.en: Fresh food has been picked or produced recently, and has not been preserved, for example by being frozen or put in a tin.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.ex: He has sixty apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有六十个苹果。
words.en: The number 60.

words.ex: He is seventy years old.
words.en: The number 70.

words.ex: He is eighty years old.
words.en: The number 80.

words.ex: He is ninety years old.
words.en: the number 90

words.ex: There are a hundred students in the hall.
words.en: The number 100; the number that is equal to ten times ten.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.

words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex_cn: 孩子们夏天喜欢在农场玩耍。
words.en: On the farm refers to being located or working within the area of a farm, which is a piece of land used for growing crops or rearing animals.

words.tr: phrase. 加油；快点；拜托；来吧；开始

words.ex_cn: 加油，你能跑完这场比赛的！

words.tr: phrase. 新年快乐的；幸福新年的

words.tr: phrase. 国际劳动节；五一劳动节
words.ex: International Workers' Day is a public holiday in many countries around the world.
words.ex_cn: 国际劳动节是世界各地许多国家的一个公共假日。

words.ex: They celebrate national day with a parade.
